name: bigquery-agent-analytics-tracing
description: SDK and plugin packaging for logging Codex or Claude agent traces to BigQuery Agent Analytics.

interface.shortDescription: Log agent traces into ADK BQAA tables.
interface.longDescription: Provides a small Python SDK and Claude Code hook bridge that write agent events in the Google ADK BigQuery Agent Analytics agent_events schema.
defaultPrompt: Instrument this agent with BQAA tracing.
Bootstrap GCP IAM and BigQuery prerequisites for BQAA tracing.
